title: Caral, Chavín and Sipán: Peru before the Incas
goal: Tell what existed in Peru before the Incas, ordering events with antes de que and después de que.
grammar: clauses with antes de que and después de que

items: I can order events with *antes de que* and *después de que* and the right mood.
I can say what Caral, Chavín and Sipán were and where they are.
I can use the new words for archaeology: *arqueólogo*, *templo*, *pirámide*, *tumba*.
